activities.title: Lantern-lit reading hour
activities.note: One chapter of the green-spined novel, phone left in the coat pocket.

activities.title: Night-market dumpling crawl
activities.note: Start at the stall with the paper lanterns, share three plates, finish with sesame balls from the cart by the east gate. Bring small change and a friend who says yes to everything.

activities.title: Stargazing from the old reservoir ridge
activities.note: Thermos of cocoa, red torch, the folding star chart.

activities.title: Sketch the bridge lights until the last tram rolls past
activities.note: Soft pencil, the small sketchbook, gloves without fingertips.
